A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Sith Saber''' was a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] sometime after the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[44 ABY]], he was part of a [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|team]] sent to [[Operation Shieldfall|capture]] the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. During the mission, he and three other [[Sith Saber]]s [[First duel in Kesla Vein|ambushed]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], and former [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]] in the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Kesla Vein]]. In the ensuing [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|fight]], the Saber was quickly [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the elder Skywalker.

==Biography==
[[File:Luke_Skywalker_EA.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Luke Skywalker, the Sith Saber's killer]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Saber]] served the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] in the time following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. [[Reproduction/Legends|Born]] on the isolated [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], he was taken and [[Sith training|trained]] by the Lost Tribe of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], descendants of a group of Sith who had been stranded on the planet thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior.<ref name="Conviction" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> the Human held the rank of Sith Saber and was chosen to be part of an [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|armada]] sent to [[Operation Shieldfall|capture]] the female [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]] on the remote planet [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]].<ref name="Conviction" />

For that mission, the Human was paired with [[Unidentified Sith Saber (Ben Skywalker victim)|two]] [[Gavar Khai's petty officer|other]] Sith and placed under the command of Sith Saber [[Tola Annax]]. After landing on Nam Chorios, the Sith Saber and his companions [[First duel in Kesla Vein|ambushed]] another group searching for Abeloth, which consisted of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], and the fugitive [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]], at a [[Kesla Vein pumping station|pumping station]] in the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Kesla Vein]]. While Annax stayed behind, the three Sabers engaged the group in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], with the Human fighting Luke Skywalker. However, after a brief [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]], the Sith was [[Sai tok/Legends|cut in two]] by the Grand Master and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] instantly.<ref name="Conviction" />

==Personality and traits==
During the time of the mission to Nam Chorios, the Sith was in good physical condition. He wore the standard attire for settlers on Nam Chorios during his mission there.<ref name="Conviction" />

==Powers and abilities==
The Sith Saber possessed the [[Force power/Legends|abilities]] required to achieve the rank of Sith Saber in the tribe.<ref name="Conviction" />

==Equipment==
The Sith Saber owned a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] containing a [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]].<ref name="Conviction" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith Saber appeared in [[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction|''Conviction'']], the seventh novel of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series. ''Conviction'' was written by author [[Aaron Allston]] and was published in [[2011]].<ref name="Conviction" />
